liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Crazy Fingers** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Crazy Fingers as exceptional and worth downloading by itself; Reviewer praises the amazing percussion during Crazy Fingers [12][22]
- **Standing On The Moon** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the guitar solo in Standing On The Moon the most beautiful guitar playing they have heard; Reviewer singles out Standing On The Moon as exceptional and worth downloading by itself [11][12]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Attendee calls Bird Song truly exploratory [21]
- **Picasso Moon** (1 review): Reviewer says Picasso Moon hits hard and the performance is intense [11]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Dark Star and the Rain encore as making the show unique [22]
- **Rain** (1 review): Attendee praises the Rain encore as a fitting close to the show [21]
- Jerry stumbles over some lyrics in one song but recovers, and his solo there is beautiful [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-12-12.fob.schoeps.gems.79599.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 150 min [1]
- **gd92-12-12.fob-boardman.evans.23220.sbeok.flac**: source not stated; 18 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording nice, though the second set is slow to get going [18]
- **gd1992-12-12.mtx.hansokolow.97937.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 151 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the matrix recording sounds great [22]
- **gd1992-12-12.150536.FOB.Schoeps.Buick.Darroch.Noel.t.flac1648**: source not stated; 16 songs; 152 min [5]
- **gd92-12-12.sbd-2track.stonebear.5549.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 144 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard's sound quality great throughout; Reviewer describes the soundboard as having good sound quality; Reviewer praises the soundboard's clarity and finds the mix decent [12][14][15][17]

## Around the show

- Jerry left the stage at one point, yet the rest of the band kept playing, with Vince singled out [11]
- Vince is described as assertive on keyboards and vocals, and stands out [17]
- Reviewer says West Coast crowds in the 90s were older, experienced and listened quietly, unlike younger East Coast crowds [18]
- Reviewer says these were among Jerry's first shows after his serious health scare that summer [19]
- Reviewer recalls Jerry returning thinner and energetic, moving and swaying with the music [19]
- Reviewer feels the band had slowed and become more soulful and contemplative by then, especially at Oakland home shows [15]
- Reviewer considers the whole Oakland Arena run good, with few major glitches across the shows [17]
- Reviewer says West Coast shows are more laid back than East Coast venues like the Spectrum and MSG [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-12-12.fob.schoeps.gems.79599.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Blingfree; source: FOB Audience Schoeps CMC54 taper: unknown [1]
- **gd92-12-12.fob-boardman.evans.23220.sbeok.flac**: taped by Ed Boardman; source: fob 30' center(from stage) hand held cmc 4,41 ortf>canare star quad cables>koch power supply > canare star quad cables>koch modified panasonic sv-255 panasonic… [2]. Also: Recorded from the front-of-board position, 30 feet from the stage center, with hand-held CMC 4 and 41 mics in ORTF; Ed Boardman taped and transferred it from DAT to CD-R; C Evans converted it to FLAC via EAC [2]
- **gd1992-12-12.mtx.hansokolow.97937.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: matrix of SBD: shnid=5549 and AUD: shnid: set 1=23220, set 2=28878 by hansokolow using ProTools [3]. Also: Matrix by hansokolow in ProTools, mixing Dan Healy's two-track PA soundboard, copied on cassette for Phil Lesh, with the audience source; The soundboard cassette was confiscated by Dick Latvala, then digitized by kingbee and seeded to etree by StoneBear [3]
- **gd1992-12-12.150536.FOB.Schoeps.Buick.Darroch.Noel.t.flac1648**: taped by Master Digital FOB Recording by Marcus Buick & Rob Darroch w/ assistance of John Ammons; transferred by Transfer by Marcus Buick Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition (2020) by Joe Noel August 08, 2020; source: Schoeps MK4 CMC3mod (ORTF, FOB)> MIT shotgun XLR > TAO/Oade PS > MIT shotgun XLR > Panasonic SV250mod > Master DAT (16bit48kHz) Location, FOB, DFC. Mic… [5]. Also: Recorded by Marcus and Rob using Schoeps mics; patch sources fill several short gaps in set two tracks; Pete Oshman's SV3800 was used; the patch work is described as virtually undetectable [5]
- **gd92-12-12.sbd-2track.stonebear.5549.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Fred Strame Grateful Dead: [1992-12-11 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-12-11-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [24]
